caveat: Timeframe alignment is descriptive. A conflict between timeframes is the normal state of a market, not an error, and alignment has not been shown to precede better returns.
narrative: 1w: bearish, mid range · 1d: range, upper third · 4h: range, at range bottom · 1h: transition, near range bottom · 15m: transition. The higher timeframe holds a direction while a lower one consolidates - a pause inside a move rather than a disagreement.
